summary: The 'CorrespondenceQueue' document is part of a web application that facilitates the handling and tracking of scheduled correspondences. It includes functionalities for displaying, filtering, deleting, and updating correspondence records within a grid view interface.
purpose: To manage and control the flow of scheduled correspondences, providing a user interface for viewing, filtering, and managing correspondence records.

fields.name: TemplateFormatted
fields.description: Field displaying the formatted template to be generated.

fields.name: PRDueDateFormatted
fields.description: Field showing the earliest due date for the correspondence.

fields.name: GeneratedDateFormatted
fields.description: Field displaying the date when the correspondence was generated.

fields.name: CorrespondenceID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the correspondence record.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Can interact with the correspondence queue by viewing, filtering, and deleting records.

workflows.name: Manage Correspondence Queue
steps: Page initializes and checks if a postback event has occurred.
User can filter correspondences by criteria such as Due Date, Program, etc.
Grid displays correspondence data; empty grid shown if no data is available.
User can delete a correspondence record using the delete command.

business_rules: A correspondence record can be deleted from the queue, which triggers an update of the cohort schedule.
The page auto-updates if a refresh action is triggered by a popup.
validations: Ensure the UserSession is not null before processing data selection.
Confirm deletion of records through JavaScript to prevent accidental removals.

conditions.description: Red color is used for due dates that are overdue and not yet generated.

system_behavior: Page refreshes upon certain user actions like popup refresh.
Data is bound to grid views after refreshing or loading.
dependencies: HSPnet.DataLayer for grid data source selection.
UserSession object to maintain user-specific data parameters.
exceptions: Handles no data found scenario by showing a specific empty data panel template.
